marble:
CONFIRMED (stated in text): Marble is the founders' own Dachshund and is female (she/her throughout). She was diagnosed with IVDD in 2024 'at just three years old'. The first signs were dragging her back legs and losing her balance. Almost overnight her owners were learning words like 'disc extrusion' and 'crate rest' (the text says they learned the words; it does not say she had either). In 2025, through testing products, reading everything and 'patience and a lot of careful monitoring', her better days started to outnumber her bad ones. The live Our Story photo caption is 'Marble — The reason it all started'. The signed-off final/our-story.html:113 heads its IVDD product rail 'What helped Marble — Back braces, lift harnesses, ramps and rest'. That is categories only: no item, brand, surgery, medication, physio, hydrotherapy or IVDD grade is ever named for her. The live Why page says 'Our founder's Dachshund, Marble, inspired our entire recovery range.' and 'If we would not give it to Marble, we will not sell it.'

APPEARANCE (from the photo only, never stated in text; three separate reads agree and I checked the image myself): one small, smooth-coated Dachshund, likely a miniature but not stated. Chocolate/brown base with silver-grey dapple mottling, heaviest on the head and ears. Tan points on the muzzle, eyebrows, legs and under the tail. Liver-brown nose, amber-brown eyes. She wears a pinkish harness on a red lead. In the only photo she is alone on a sunlit woodland path among bluebells, body angled away, head turned back over her shoulder to the camera. Real file: /home/user/Cloud/video/pro3/marble/src/marble.jpg (3574x2537); the site copy is saved at scratchpad/site/marble.jpg. Do not treat the name 'Marble' as evidence of her coat.

THE 'THREE DOGS LOOKING BACK' NOTE: I checked raw/C08-C10. The S12 Labrador, terrier cross and greyhound are each painted body-away with the head twisted back to copy Marble's pose. The Labrador and greyhound neck turns look strained and unnatural. The look-back is Marble's real, one-off pose from her single photo. Nothing in the sources requires other dogs to repeat it, and those three dogs are invented 'every dog' stand-ins, not customers.

PLANNED PHOTO SLOTS (all placeholders): 'Marble', 'Marble resting', 'Marble on a good day', 'Joe and Lily with Marble', 'Marble today'. The client may have these photos.

NOT KNOWN: her current age, health today, weight, and life before 2024.

what_poorly_pet_offers:
POSITIONING: 'UK pet health, recovery and mobility specialist' (signed-off/home.html title). 'Everything a poorly dog needs, in one place.' 'Better days start with the right support.' (live Our Story h1). 'More than a pet store. A partner in better days.' (live Why). 'Calmer, clearer care for every dog owner.' (live Our Mission).

TWO WAYS TO SHOP: by condition ('Know the condition? Go straight to it.') or by symptom ('Not sure? Start with what you can see.'). 'Two ways in. Both end at the right shelf.'

CONDITION AREAS (8):
- Mobility & Joint: arthritis, hip dysplasia, IVDD, cruciate ligament, luxating patella, elbow dysplasia, rear-leg weakness, back pain, spondylosis
- Paws & Limbs: knuckling, carpal hyperextension, hock & Achilles, paw care
- Internal Health: digestive issues, kidney support, weight management
- Skin & Allergies: itchy skin, hot spots, seasonal allergies, ear & eye care
- Behaviour & Mood: anxiety, separation anxiety, noise and firework fear, restlessness
- Essential Care: dental disease, wound and post-surgery
- Neurological: degenerative myelopathy, paralysis, nerve weakness
- Rehab: hydrotherapy, physiotherapy, post-surgery recovery

SYMPTOM AREAS (8): Legs & paws, Skin & coat, Tummy & gut, Eyes & ears, Mouth & teeth, Back & spine, Behaviour & mood, Whole body. Back & spine signs: yelping when touched, hunched or arched posture, reluctant to jump or climb, wobbly back legs, sudden rear weakness.

AFFORDABLE PRODUCT TYPES SAFE TO SHOW: support and lift harnesses, back braces, ramps, carpal support wraps, recovery shirts and soft collars, cooling mats and quilted or crate mattresses, salmon oil and joint supplements, calming diffusers, sprays and lick mats, dental bites and gels, grooming and paw balm.

Example IVDD prices, verbatim from the repo rail (check before use): Danish Design Crate Mattress £16.99; Drag Bag £42.99; Thermal Back Brace £54.99; Rear Lift Harness £54.99; No-Knuckling Sling £59.99; Balto Neck brace £70.00; Adjustable Wooden Ramp £79.99. Balto Body Lift at £120.00 is borderline. Wheelchairs (£179.99–£429.99) and every bundle or care kit are out.

GUIDES (free advice hub): IVDD ('Disc disease, and the long-backed dogs who get it.'), itchy skin, 'Arthritis in older dogs', 'Why is my dog limping?', 'Recovery suits versus the cone, honestly', hot spots, firework season. Advice tone: 'Rehabilitation is about helping your dog rebuild comfort, confidence and mobility at the right pace.'

SERVICE (confirmed by policy or the signed-off final pages):
- 'Free UK delivery over £39'
- UK delivery only
- Dispatch typically 1–2 working days; standard delivery usually 2–4 working days after dispatch; tracking emailed (shipping policy, last updated 22 June 2026; BRIEF.md 'confirmed')
- Returns: 14 days to cancel plus 14 days to return; refund within 14 days; faulty items covered; opened consumables not returnable unless faulty
- Email replies 'within one working day', Monday to Friday, 9am–5pm (signed-off pages; the live contact page says 1–2 working days)
- '10% off your first order' with code POORLY10
- Poorly Pet Club, free to join: 5 points per £1, 500 points = £5 off, no minimum spend
- Subscribe & save 5% / 10% / 15% for 8-, 4- or 2-weekly deliveries, cancel any time (live FAQ)
- Reviews collected by Judge.me from verified orders ('Every review is from a verified order, collected by Judge.me.')
- Payments: Visa, Mastercard, Amex, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna
- Contact: hello@poorly-pet.com

conflicts: REVIEW COUNT: the brief approves 'Rated 4.6/5 from 99 reviews', which matches the approved film and the older signed-off/ shop pages ('99 verified reviews on Judge.me'). But the live site (footer '101+', reviews page 'Based on 101 verified reviews'), the newer signed-off final/our-story.html and final/customer-reviews.html, and all new-pages drafts now say 101. Pick: keep the approved 99 line verbatim and ask the client whether to update it to 101. Never use 4.9/5 (live Our Mission and a homepage counter), which contradicts Judge.me.

WORDING 'found' vs 'kept': live Our Story says 'found what genuinely helped'. The signed-off final/our-story.html:97, all six drafts and the approved film say 'kept what genuinely helped'. Both are approved; the live wording is preferred for sourcing.

'helping her recover' (live hero) vs 'helping her' (signed-off final/our-story.html:79 and drafts). The repo removed 'recover'. Pick the repo version for screen, because it keeps clear of any recovery or cure reading.

PUNCTUATION: live uses em dashes and 'We'd' / 'we'd learned'. The repo uses full stops or colons and 'We had' / 'we had learned'. Live writes 'Built for Marble, here for every dog.'; the repo and film write 'Built for Marble. Here for every dog.' Either is fine; keep the film's two-sentence tagline for consistency.

STORY STRUCTURE: the live Our Story has 4 dated steps (2024, 2024, 2025, 2025 'Poorly Pet was born'). The repo drafts have 5 chapters, adding 'End of 2025' as a label and 'Today · Here for every dog'. The final cut relabels them 'Late 2025 · Sandbach, Cheshire' and 'Today · Dogs like Marble'. No dates contradict.
FOUNDER COUNT: live Why page says 'Our founder's Dachshund' (singular). Our Story names Joe and Lily. Pick Joe and Lily.

CRATE REST: the prior-scripts sweep lists 'crate rest at night was part of Marble's recovery' as stated. The text only says they were learning the words 'disc extrusion' and 'crate rest', and the crate scene is painted illustration. Downgraded to implied.

WHAT HELPED MARBLE: only Our Story A, which is the version signed off as final/our-story.html, heads the IVDD rail 'What helped Marble' (back braces, lift harnesses, ramps and rest). Our Story B/C call it 'Our IVDD range', and the live page has no such heading. Usable as categories only.
FREE DELIVERY THRESHOLD: £39 (banner, shipping policy, signed-off pages, approved film) vs £40 (live /pages/delivery and FAQ). BRIEF.md says to follow the policy. Pick £39 as approved.
